open_release.rationale: Model weights are restricted to credentialed MIMIC-CXR researchers, and the sources do not frame the images as a shareable substitute.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing purpose appears in the sources.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The paper uses synthetic chest x-rays as data augmentation and measures classifier gains.

quotes.text: Fine-tuning this model on a fixed training set and using it as a data augmentation method, we measure a 5% improvement of a classifier trained jointly on synthetic and real images, and a 3% improvement when trained on a larger but purely synthetic training set.

statistical_replication.rationale: Image fidelity and diversity are evaluated with FID and MS-SSIM against real images.

quotes.text: We assess the model outputs quantitatively using image quality metrics, and evaluate image quality and text-image alignment by human domain experts.

education.rationale: No teaching or demonstration-for-learning framing appears in the sources.

benchmarking.rationale: RoentGen is the proposed model; the sources do not show it used as a baseline or benchmark data.

imbalance_correction.rationale: The paper only caps the No Finding class in its training split and does not oversample a rare class.
